title: Item Behavior Document
description: A behavior pack item definition document for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. This describes the complete JSON file structure including format_version and the minecraft:item wrapper. Items define the properties, components, and behaviors of custom items that can be obtained and used by players.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: The format version of this item behavior file. Determines which features and component schemas are available. Use '1.20.20' or later for the latest item component system.

minecraft:item.title: Item Definition
minecraft:item.description:
The item definition container with description and components sections.

Properties:
• description (object)
• components (object)

description.title: Description
description.description:
Contains the item's unique identifier and optional menu category placement.

Properties:
• identifier (string)
• menu_category (object) = {"category":"none","

defaultSnippets.label: Item Description
defaultSnippets.description: Contains the required identifier for the item. May contain optional fields like menu_category.

components.title: Components
components.description: The components that define this item's behavior, appearance, and interactions.

defaultSnippets.label: Item Definition
defaultSnippets.description: The item definition container with description and components sections.

item_menu_category.title: Item Menu Category
item_menu_category.description: menu_category contains the creative group name and category for this item.

category.title: CreativeItemCategory
category.description: Creative category where this item belongs. Defaults to "none".

group.title: Group
group.description: The Creative Group that this item belongs to. Group name is limited to 256 characters. The name also must start with a namespace.

is_hidden_in_commands.title: Is Hidden In Commands
is_hidden_in_commands.description: Determines whether or not this item can be used with commands. Defaults to false.

item_description.title: Item Description
item_description.description: Contains the required identifier for the item. May contain optional fields like menu_category.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: Unique name for the item that must include a namespace and must not use the Minecraft namespace unless overriding a Vanilla item.

menu_category.title: Menu Category
menu_category.description:
menu_category contains the creative group name and category for this item.

Properties:
• category (string) = none
• group (string)
• is_hidden_in_commands (boolean)

defaultSnippets.label: Item Menu Category
defaultSnippets.description: menu_category contains the creative group name and category for this item.
